name: Eden
title: Levite in the Time of King Hezekiah
summary: Eden was a Levite who served under King Hezekiah of Judah. He was among those entrusted with the responsibility of distributing voluntary offerings and sacrifices to the Lord among the priests and Levites. He is mentioned in connection with Hezekiah's religious reforms and the reopening of temple service.

keyEvents.title: Hezekiah's Temple Reform
keyEvents.description: King Hezekiah carried out a major religious reform in which the temple was cleansed and worship restored. The Levites, including Eden, played an important role in this process.

keyEvents.title: Distribution of Offerings
keyEvents.description: Eden was appointed as one of those responsible for distributing voluntary offerings, tithes, and holy gifts to the priests and Levites in the cities.

keyEvents.title: Service under Kore
keyEvents.description: Eden served under the supervision of Kore, son of Imnah, who was in charge of the offerings at God's house. Eden was among his trusted assistants.

keyEvents.title: Faithful Stewardship of Holy Gifts
keyEvents.description: Eden and the other Levites were entrusted with distributing the gifts fairly to all the priests and Levites, both great and small, according to their service divisions.
